Wiki pages are full of characters that mean something in Markdown. The renderer escapes the ones that would change the output, and only those.

- not a list item
+ not one either
1. not an ordered list
1) and not this
> not a quote
#hashtag is an ordered item in wikitext, <nowiki>#hashtag</nowiki> is text

--- not a rule ---
===

2 * 3 * 4 = 24, a_b_c, snake_case_name, **stars**, _underscores_, ~~tildes~~, `backticks`
<nowiki>[a link](https://example.com) and ![an image](https://example.com/x.png) and [a reference][1]</nowiki>
[brackets] without nowiki are an external link
<https://example.com> and a < b > c, &amp; &copy;
| not | a | table |
| --- | --- | --- |
\ a backslash, C:\Users\alice, \*already escaped\*
:smile: @alice

<nowiki># not a heading or an ordered item</nowiki>
<nowiki>* not a list item</nowiki>
<nowiki><div class="note">HTML</div>, <b>bold</b>, <!-- comment --></nowiki>

'''Wikitext still works''' in the middle of it: ''2 * 3'', [https://example.com/a_b a_b].
